prompt: Clean up this photo of the empty chair room: the battered robot in the centre becomes small and spotless, about a third of its current size, smooth pale grey with no mud, scratches or bunting, its orange lamp lit; and the crumpled white suit and the pair of black gloves on the floor in the foreground are gone, leaving bare white tiles and cables there.
